name: Avasol
tagline: Surfer-made organic mineral SPF in refillable sticks
story: Santa Barbara waterman Chris Wilkinson started Avasol in 2010 after he couldn’t find a sunscreen he’d put on his kids and still trust in the lineup — non-nano zinc, organic botanicals, and biobased refillable tubes.

name: Sol de Ibiza
tagline: Plastic-free Mediterranean mineral sun care
story: Family-run Ibiza sun care in reusable tins and cardboard sticks — certified organic mineral formulas that hydrate like a cream and stay off the reef.

name: SurfDurt
tagline: Reef-safe mineral SPF in bamboo you can reuse
story: California surfers Max and Nikki mixed their own non-nano zinc sunscreen, then packed it in bamboo and aluminum so the ocean doesn’t inherit another plastic tube.

name: Rebrand Skincare
tagline: Toxicologist-built refillable mineral SPF and skin
story: A toxicologist-herbalist shortlist — wildcrafted and organic botanicals, 1% for the Planet, and a daily mineral SPF designed to refill instead of landfill.

name: UNTAMMED
tagline: Four-ingredient real-food electrolyte mix
story: Coconut water, sea salt, magnesium chloride, and actual fruit — no stevia, no monk fruit, no “natural flavors.” Hydration that reads like a grocery list.

name: Nectar
tagline: Short-list daily hydration with real organic fruit
story: Seven-ingredient electrolyte packets flavored with organic fruit instead of a lab — clean everyday hydration without the candy-aisle aftertaste.

name: POSSIBLE
tagline: Whole-food electrolytes grown on an organic farm
story: Wisconsin farm–grown mountain spinach, barley grass, coconut water, and sea salt — plant-sourced minerals instead of a synthetic salt pile.

name: Ora Organic
tagline: Chef-crafted USDA organic plant protein
story: San Diego organic protein and wellness with public third-party tests — no gums, no stevia circus, just plant proteins and enzymes you can actually digest.

name: Puori
tagline: Clean Label Project–tested grass-fed whey
story: Danish purity nerds who publish every batch test against 200+ contaminants — grass-fed whey and clean supplements with receipts, not vibes.

name: Mikuna
tagline: Single-ingredient Andean chocho protein
story: Lupinus mutabilis grown with Kichwa farmers at 11,000 feet — 20g complete protein, 8g fiber, no gums, no sweeteners, lot-tested for metals and pesticides.

name: PiperWai
tagline: Activated-charcoal cream deodorant from a Philly kitchen
story: Sarah and Jess mixed a hundred kitchen batches until charcoal, magnesium, and butters actually lasted all day — vegan, aluminum-free, and still independent after Shark Tank.

name: LATHR
tagline: Small-batch Canadian deodorant without baking soda
story: Poured by hand in Woodbridge, Ontario — magnesium and zinc sticks that skip aluminum and baking soda so pits stay calm and shirts stay unstained.

name: NOBS
tagline: Dentist-made hydroxyapatite toothpaste tablets
story: Chewable n-HA tablets in glass — fluoride-free enamel support without the plastic tube, formulated by a dentist who was tired of junk in toothpaste.

name: Uncle Harry's
tagline: Glass-jar natural toothpaste and herbal mouthwash
story: Old-school herbal oral care in glass — fluoride-free pastes, powders, and miracle mouthwash with ingredients you can pronounce and refill.

name: Marie Veronique
tagline: Berkeley-made clean clinical skin science
story: Chemist Marie Veronique Nadeau builds barrier-first serums and mineral sun care with a short, serious ingredient list — no endocrine circus, no filler fog.

name: Okoko Cosmétiques
tagline: Montreal botanical luxury with a clean conscience
story: Small-batch Canadian botanicals — oils, serums, and creams that treat plants like actives, not perfume, and skip the usual synthetic pile-on.

name: NUELE
tagline: Zero-synthetic bond care for every texture
story: Founded by Black women who were tired of bond builders ignoring coils — 100% naturally derived actives, fair-trade oils from Ghana and Morocco, lab-tested on real strands.

name: Sienna Naturals
tagline: Clean, clinically tested care for textured hair
story: Issa Rae and Hannah Diop built a plant-based wash-day system for coils and curls — dermatologist-tested, silicone-skipping formulas that treat scalp health as the main event.

name: FullWell
tagline: Practitioner-formulated prenatal nutrition
story: Dietitian Ayla Barmmer’s prenatal and fertility line — methylated B vitamins, mineral forms you can absorb, and labels written for people who actually read them.

name: Real Mushrooms
tagline: Fruiting-body mushroom extracts, no grain filler
story: Mushroom supplements that are actually mushrooms — organic fruiting bodies, measured beta-glucans, and none of the mycelium-on-oats dust most jars hide.
